name: Recherche de rushes
description: Finds a shot in hours of footage by describing it (« plan zénith du plat », « a wide shot of the beach »). « Indexer les rushes » embeds one frame every 2 seconds of the project's video media with SigLIP 2 (optional model siglip2-base-224, 1.5 GB, Apache-2.0); « Chercher » (--var query="...") lists the best moments with their timecode and puts a marker on the media at each hit.
author: FilmCraft
